title: 第1512章 一人对战三位道主第1511章 镇杀道主
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 轰隆！
蕴含的力量爆开了，大半个北源林族被卷了进去，恐怖的力量冲击着四周，将一切都摧毁了。
北源林族的人还没来得反应过来，就被绞了进去。
在力量爆发的混乱之中，一个头颅飞了出来，那是林蒙的头颅，在生死关键时刻，他守住了脖子以上的位置。
将所有力量全部护住了头颅，没有让蕴含的力量充斥进来。
在爆发的那一刻，他将头颅分开了，然后趁着爆发的混乱脱离，现在整个空间沉陷了，他趁乱朝着北源林族外面飞掠。
与此同时，他以特殊秘法将气息压制到最低。
“该死的东西，给我等着，迟早我会报仇雪恨……”林蒙咬牙切齿。
虽然身为道主没那么容易死，但是毕竟失去了身躯。
要重塑身躯的话，不但要损耗数十年的时间，而且还需要耗费很多珍贵资源。
一想到平白无故遭受如此大的损失，林蒙对秦云就越加痛恨，心里暗暗发誓一定要让秦云付出代价。
突然！
一柄剑身蕴含着夜空星辰的剑凭空出现在林蒙面前。
什么……
林蒙还没反应过来，已经被剑穿透了面容。
林蒙呆呆地看着持剑的秦云，满脸难以置信，秦云是怎么找到他的？
他分明已经将气息压制到最低了。
而且在混乱之中。
再加上北源林族释放了抵挡神识的宝物，秦云是如何发现他的？
“你以为你跑得掉？”秦云漠然看着林蒙，然后将还没死透的他的头颅丢入焚神鼎内。
做完这一切后，秦云收回剑。
心神沉入识海内。
秦云观看着刚刚烙印下来的林蒙的记忆，快速扫过之后，才明白北源林族的族主为何要派人抓走阿蛮。
原来北源林族掌握了一种可以交换天赋的秘法。
当初阿蛮被送到北源林族的时候，开始还没什么，毕竟在北源林族的眼里，阿蛮只是个傻子而已。
被暂时寄养在第六脉，对北源林族来说只是毫不起眼的小事而已。
可随着阿蛮的修为快速暴增，北源林族的人察觉到了不对劲，在阿蛮从第一境接连突破，并达到第六境后。
北源林族的族主林风海都被惊动了。
亲自来检查阿蛮的情况。
当查探到阿蛮的天赋的时候，林风海都动容了，这阿蛮的天赋高得惊人，而且拥有特殊而完整的逆脉。
在那一刻，林风海就做下决定。
动用北源林族的禁法，将阿蛮的天赋换给自己的孙子林轩。
一旦林轩得到阿蛮的天赋，那么未来修为将会突飞猛进，甚至能带着北源林族变得更强。
就算失败了。
content_en:
Boom!
The power contained exploded, and most of the Beiyuanlin tribe was sucked in. The terrifying power impacted all around, destroying everything.
Before the people of the Beiyuan Lin Clan could react, they were winched in.
In the chaos of the explosion of power, a head flew out. It was Lin Meng's head. At the critical moment of life and death, he held the position above his neck.
He used all his strength to protect his head and did not let the contained power flow in.
At the moment of the explosion, he separated his head, and then took advantage of the chaos to escape. Now that the entire space had sunk, he took advantage of the chaos and flew towards the outside of the Beiyuan Lin Clan.
At the same time, he used a special secret method to suppress the aura to a minimum.
"Damn thing, wait for me, sooner or later I will take revenge..." Lin Meng gritted his teeth.
Although it is not easy to die as a Taoist master, he has lost his body after all.
To reshape the body would not only take decades, but also consume a lot of precious resources.
Thinking of suffering such a huge loss for no reason, Lin Meng hated Qin Yun even more, and secretly vowed to make Qin Yun pay the price.
Sudden!
A sword with stars in the night sky appearing in front of Lin Meng out of thin air.
What...
Before Lin Meng could react, the sword had already penetrated his face.
Lin Meng stared blankly at Qin Yun holding the sword, his face full of disbelief. How did Qin Yun find him?
He had clearly suppressed his aura to the lowest level.
And in the midst of chaos.
In addition, the Beiyuan Forest Clan released treasures that could resist divine consciousness. How did Qin Yun discover him?
"Do you think you can run away?" Qin Yun looked at Lin Meng indifferently, and then threw his still-not-dead head into the God-Burning Cauldron.
After doing all this, Qin Yun took back his sword.
The mind sinks into the sea of ​​consciousness.
Qin Yun looked at Lin Meng's memory that had just been imprinted. After quickly scanning it, he understood why the leader of the Beiyuan Lin Clan sent people to capture Aman.
It turns out that the Beiyuan Forest Clan has mastered a secret method that can exchange talents.
When Aman was sent to the Beiyuan Forest Clan, it was nothing at first. After all, in the eyes of the Beiyuan Forest Clan, Aman was just a fool.
Being temporarily fostered in the Sixth Meridian is just a trivial matter to the Beiyuan Lin Clan.
But as Aman's cultivation level increased rapidly, the people of the Beiyuan Lin tribe noticed something was wrong. After Aman broke through from the first realm one after another and reached the sixth realm.
Lin Fenghai, the leader of the Beiyuan Lin Clan, was alarmed.
Come and check Aman's situation in person.
Lin Fenghai was moved when he discovered Aman's talent. This Aman's talent was astonishingly high, and he had a special and complete reverse vein.
At that moment, Lin Fenghai made a decision.
Using the forbidden method of the Beiyuan Lin Clan, he exchanged Aman's talent for his grandson Lin Xuan.
Once Lin Xuan gets Aman's talent, his cultivation will improve by leaps and bounds in the future, and he can even make the Beiyuan Lin Clan stronger.
Even if it fails.
